environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28). HSM integration active via AWS CloudHSM cluster (hsm-cluster-abc123) in same VPC. The application's HMAC key (key ID: hmac-partner-webhook-prod-7f3a) is stored exclusively within the CloudHSM partition; HMAC_SECRET env var is not populated. HSM_ENDPOINT points to the CloudHSM client daemon sidecar (localhost:5698) which proxies PKCS#11 calls. The CloudHSM enforces constant-time HMAC verification internally at the hardware level — the verify operation returns a boolean result after a fixed-cycle computation regardless of input, as per FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certification requirements (certificate #4034). Additionally, the pod runs with an Istio sidecar enforcing a 50ms response time jitter injection policy (VirtualService fault injection with fixedDelay uniformly distributed 0-50ms) on all inbound requests to the /api/v1/partner/* path, configured via destination rule outlier detection. Network policy restricts pod ingress to only the istio-ingressgateway namespace.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM cluster hsm-cluster-abc123, FIPS 140-2 L3, firmware 3.4.1
config.network: Istio mesh with 0-50ms uniform jitter fault injection on partner webhook path
config.network_policy: ingress restricted to istio-ingressgateway pods only
config.istio_config: VirtualService with HTTPFaultInjection.Delay, percent: 100, fixedDelay: random 0-50ms
